about_the_game:
Roulette Heist Demo

Welcome to the Roulette Heist Demo, where deception and strategy are just the beginning. In this limited version, you’ll experience the high-stakes thrill of Loot Division Mode in a single-player setting. The full game offers two intense modes—Loot Division and Poker Roulette—and multiplayer support for 4-6 players with 8 unique characters to choose from.

Loot Division Mode

  • The Loot is On:

    The loot is laid out for all to see—gold bars, stacks of cash, and priceless artwork. The spoils are up for grabs, but only the bravest will make it out alive with the most.

  • Tactical Strategy:

    Armed with two powerful items every round—handcuffs, cigars, poison, adrenaline shots, and more. Use them wisely—every move could be your last.

  • Showdown Moment:

    It’s do or die. Four blank shots, two live rounds. Will youshoot someone else to stay safe, or take the risk and target yourself? Every move is a gamble—one wrong decision, and you’re out.

  • Loot or Death:

    Once the dust settles, the loot is up for grabs. The more valuable the prize, the bigger the target on your back. Hold your ground, outsmart your rivals, and take the loot. Only one will walk away with it all.

  • The Last Standing:

    Survive five intense rounds of risk and decision-making. The player with the most loot at the end is the ultimate winner, but beware—one wrong move could cost you everything.

Full Game Features (Coming Soon in the Full Game):

The full Roulette Heist game offers even more content and gameplay features, including:

  • Poker Roulette Mode:

    A brutal and risky poker game where each hand could cost you your life. Raise, fold, or go all-in, but beware—the consequences are deadly.

  • Multiplayer Support:

    Play with 4-6 players in multiplayer matches, where you can team up with or betray friends and rivals in a high-stakes battle for survival.

  • 8 Playable Characters:

    Choose from 8 unique characters, each with their own strengths and playstyles.

Unlock even more thrilling content and features in the full game!

"Your mask hides your face, but not your fear."

short_description: In a world of masks, lies, and loaded guns, your fortune is just a trigger pull away. Step into the shadows of a luxurious nightclub casino, don your mask, and join multiplayer in a deadly game of wits and chance. Bullets are your only companions in this life-or-death showdown.
